summary.queueCountingRule: Unique cityKey, first-wins priority: 341 cities whose roster parent_county_fips is in the signed 28-county footprint; then 99 additional NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY cities outside the footprint. The 155 Dallas-metro lowercase searched-and-absent rows are already contained in the 341 footprint. The roster-wide 158 figure includes three non-DFW homonyms and is not the A-006 Dallas set.
summary.productionStopReason: Frisco was assigned a Denton Parks layer while known Elgin and Georgetown zoning were both missed. Continuing --stage-apply would violate fail-closed and geometry+field identity rules. The dispatch forbade rebuilding, so the lane stopped and recorded required repairs instead of editing the factory.

roster.reason: Invalid pilot verdicts must not overwrite roster truth. Houston's correct verdict was already present. Planner commits no roster diff from L20.

cityCountyJoin.method: TxGIO City_Boundaries spatial join vs TIGER State_County (migration 0070 sources)
cityCountyJoin.countingRule: A city belongs to the footprint iff cities[].parent_county_fips is one of the signed 28 FIPS. Count once under parent_county_fips; do not explode all_county_fips. Null/unlinked parent counties are excluded.

dc6Price.scope: Current valid store+roster baseline after the stopped pilot. This is a lower-bound price, not the intended post-sweep price.

countingRules.totalCities: Roster cities counted once under parent_county_fips in the signed 28-county footprint.
countingRules.stagedCities: Distinct tx_zoning_district_staging.city_key in the county, joined to roster through Z1 geoid->cityKey. Ready-for-drain input only; not a satisfied ledger cell.
countingRules.honestAbsence: Non-staged roster city with positive-evidence status NO-ZONING-AUTHORITY, NO-EUCLIDEAN-REGIME, or ORDINANCE-NO-GIS.
countingRules.authWalled: Non-staged roster city with status AUTH-WALLED.
countingRules.nfuw: Non-staged roster city with status NOT-FOUND-UNKNOWN-WHY.
countingRules.noStatusOrLegacyOpen: Non-staged roster city lacking a seven-status value, including legacy lowercase searched-and-absent and never-classified rows.
countingRules.genuinelyOpenCities: totalCities - stagedCities - honestAbsence. AUTH-WALLED, HOST-BROKEN, NFUW, and no-status rows remain open.
countingRules.countyStatus: A county is not satisfied merely because one city is staged. Any genuinelyOpenCities > 0 is genuinely open. Candidate-satisfied counties still require drain+stamp+score and live ledger verification.

stagedCityRatio.rule: distinct staged city_key / roster cities in footprint

countiesWithAnyStaging.rule: counties with >=1 distinct staged city / 28 signed footprint counties

candidateCompleteAtCityInventory.rule: all roster cities are staged or positively absent; still not ledger-satisfied until drain+stamp+score

genuinelyOpenCounties.rule: county has >=1 incorporated city neither staged nor positively absent
